description: Upload an .apk, .aab or .ipa to a buildtree project and get back install URLs plus a QR code image. Omit `branch` to publish the environment's checkpoint (the build QA should grab); pass `branch` for a pre-merge preview. `file` defaults to the artifact from the last buildtree_build.

branch.description: Branch or feature name for a pre-merge preview. Omit for the env checkpoint.

file.description: Absolute path to the .apk/.aab/.ipa. Defaults to the last built artifact.

project.description: Project slug (see buildtree_list_projects). Defaults to the last used project.

qr.description: Include the QR code image in the result.

release.description: Release tag, e.g. v1.5.0, to also get a frozen release URL.

name: buildtree_upload
title: Upload a build
